metadata_checks.finding: Lithuania recalculated 2012-2020 immigration after the 2021 census to include estimated undeclared immigration of Lithuanian citizens.
Direct net migration is immigration minus emigration and differs from a population-balance migration-plus-adjustment residual.
Lithuania included among countries with revised intercensal population time series.

public_scope: 2012-01-01 to 2025-01-01 stocks and 2012-2024 events; original 2010-2025 calculation retained as documented context
